crossRefs.note: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burns against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against them and has struck them.…
I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by.…

translations.web: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.
translations.bsb: This is the plan devised for the whole earth, and this is the hand stretched out over all the nations.
translations.kjv: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
translations.asv: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth; and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
